stem.text: A sphere is acted upon by various forces, all of the same magnitude.
Which system of forces provides a resultant torque but zero resultant force on the sphere?

A.alt: Circle with two upward arrows above it and one downward arrow below it.

B.alt: Circle with two upward arrows above it and one downward arrow below it, on the right.

C.alt: Circle with one upward arrow above it and one downward arrow below it, on a vertical line through its centre.

D.alt: Circle with one upward arrow above it and one downward arrow below it, along its left edge.
